text: こちらも　ポケモンを　もって　いれば　たたかえるのだが…　そうじゃ！

structure.jp: こちらも　ポケモンを　もって　いれば
structure.en: if we had a Pokémon too

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: Changing the end of a verb to ば makes it 'if'. もって　いれば = 'if we had (one)'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing たたかう to たたかえる turns 'fight' into 'can fight'. たたかえる = 'could fight'.

patterns.name: 〜のだが
patterns.explanation: のだ gives the feel of explaining the situation, and が adds 'but' and trails off, hinting that it is not so. たたかえるのだが = 'we could fight, but...'.
